learning_outcomes.text: Understand the fundamentals of optical waveguides.
Understand the principles of electromagnetic wave transmission in fiber optic cables and learn the factors affecting fiber optic communication.
Learn the structure, operating principle, optical amplifiers, photodetectors, solar cells, and applications of LEDs.
Gain general knowledge about the scope of the optoelectronic industry and its impact on daily life.

syllabus_topics: Light Waves in a Homogeneous Medium, Maxwell's Wave Equation, Refractive Index and Dispersion
Snell's Law and Total Internal Reflection, Fresnel Equations, Antireflection Coatings
Step-Index Fiber Optics, Modal Dispersion in Multimode Fiber Optics, Bit Rate
Graded-Index Fiber Optics, Signal Attenuation, Fiber Optic Cable Production
Light Emitting Diodes (LED): Principles, LED Materials and Structures
Stimulated Emission Devices: Optical Amplifiers and Lasers
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan; they are held on dates specified in the academic calendar by the University Senate decision.
bibliography: The lecturer's course notes will be used.
Wilson, J. F. B. Hawkes, Optoelectronics: An Introduction, Pearson
S. O. Kasap, Optoelectronics and Photonics: Principles and Practices, Prentice Hall, 2001.
